# From Japan to Canada

> > Exploring the Canada-Japan medical tourism relationship, focusing on mental health, addiction recovery, and holistic wellness practices like Zen meditation and shinrin-yoku (forest bathing).

This site examines the growing bilateral healthcare exchange between Canada and Japan, highlighting how Canadians are increasingly seeking mental health and addiction treatment in Japan through holistic approaches including forest bathing, Zen meditation, and traditional Japanese wellness practices. It provides comparative analysis of both healthcare systems and explores the cultural and clinical dimensions of cross-Pacific medical tourism.

## Key Topics

- Canada-Japan medical tourism
- Mental health treatment
- Addiction recovery
- Zen meditation
- Shinrin-yoku (forest bathing)
- Holistic wellness
- International healthcare collaboration
- Japanese wellness practices
- Canadian healthcare system
- Omotenashi (Japanese hospitality)
- Cross-border medical services
- Nature-based therapy
- Mindfulness therapy
- Healthcare system comparison
- Medical travel
